plugins.name: anamnesis
plugins.description: Persistent, encrypted memory for Claude Code. Deterministic capture via SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/Stop/SessionEnd hooks. Per-user HKDF-derived keys — vendor cannot decrypt your memory. OAuth 2.1 + PKCE connector auth (0.3.0): first connect opens a browser for consent, tokens land in the system keychain, nothing in shell env. Visible, searchable, deletable memory surface at anamnesis.smtry.ai.
